evidence.description: Eight measured C/Ada executions with executable/script hashes and outputs.
1305 successful AUnit cases including new visibility test.

findings.rationale: The modified span retains representable and gross out-of-range cases and additionally tests the adjacent native boundary. The fixed timestamp is witnessed in UTC; conversion to local calendar fields preserves ambient-zone semantics before incrementing exactly one second. Actual pinned C and Ada executions pass in JST-9 and UTC0. This addresses the missing boundary invariant without asserting C-int maximum-year portability.

The writer is opened writable and explicitly unbuffered. A second reader is opened before a checked NUL-containing write and reads the exact thirteen bytes before any writer flush, seek or close. Both handles are closed and the temporary file removed. The AUnit case and shared C/Ada counterpart test observable visibility rather than setvbuf return alone.

limits: This cross-review covers the fixes authored by the independent files reviewer, not unrelated original implementation authored by this reviewer.
Complete final-revision and macOS evidence, source/API ledger resolution and full scoped acceptance remain pending.
